what: Post-table login fixture expects grep -Fxc count of 1 for exact line model_provider = "openai-larch-env" on login-home/config.toml
scenario_or_breakage: copied-config.toml has two exact selector lines (top-level and nested under [model_providers.other]); login-path strip removes both, and assert_top_level_not_line already requires zero top-level matches. A count==1 assertion conflicts with current fixture and existing pass logic, yielding a permanent false failure or forcing a wrong strip expectation
suggested_fix: Require grep -Fxc == 0 for exact model_provider = "openai-larch-env" and env_key = "OPENAI_API_KEY" on login-home/config.toml (or drop the count and keep assert_top_level_not_line / table-scoped checks)
